title: Fetched statistics are discarded when any table statistics already exist.

proposal_metadata.summary: Merge newly fetched statistics fields into an existing cached table entry while preserving its identity and unrelated fields.
review: Independent patch generated directly from pinned base; production worktrees unchanged.
validation_plan: Direct helper checks for cached sketch plus fetched histogram, another column, partial tuple statistics, absent incoming fields and duplicate responses.
Check optional zero values are retained and no incoming absence erases cached data.
Assert existing intrusive map pointer remains identical and an initially absent entry is installed.
Build KQP opt and RBO statistics suites.
limits: Independent Q18 patch retains the existing Issues gate; Q19 separately allows partial successful responses with diagnostics.
Request-to-request merging is intentionally unchanged to keep this patch limited to cache application.

checks: Definition and declaration now both use NYql::TOptimizerStatistics::TColumnStatMap; branch amended using isolated Git index without modifying checked-out sources
verification_limitation: Source preparation only; compilation, native semantics and optimization evidence still required.

superseded_commits.reason: Qualified shared-cache statistics map type to match header declaration
